definition: to invent a story on the spot
description: At night on a beach under a full moon, a young woman with long curly hair, in a cream cable-knit sweater and denim shorts, stands behind a crackling campfire holding up a piece of driftwood, flinging her arms wide and leaning forward with her mouth open as she tells a dramatic story. Sparks fly into the dark. Friends listen around the fire: a young woman wrapped in a blanket stares wide-eyed, someone holds a marshmallow on a stick and a scruffy dog barks up at her. A guitar and an enamel mug lie in the sand.

taps.phrase: to wave a piece of driftwood
